name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help in departments of the VA medical center. Past tasks include serving coffee, showing patients the way, helping in clinics and helping with fun programs. You learn about health care jobs.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 17. The program fills 50 slots. Your placement depends on what jobs are open.
pay_detail: Unpaid. A past year offered a certificate for 80 or more hours, a polo shirt, free parking and lunch on days of 4 or more hours.
duration: Summer. The length is not listed.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 15, 2026, with orientation on May 30, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: To apply, email Mauricio Sanchez at mauricio.sanchez@va.gov. You can also call 858-642-3267. Ask for details when you do.
notes: Closed now. The dates here are from 2026, so check back in spring 2027. The tasks and perks come from the 2024 part of the VA page and may change. The office is at 3350 La Jolla Village Drive, room 1603.
